title: Download a scoped follow-up status summary as Excel
description: A salesperson downloads the current filtered-set overdue/today/upcoming totals as a small Excel summary from the dynamic follow-up designer. Add a dedicated bounded endpoint that reruns the existing authorized preview and derives its status totals, never reading unscoped records; it does not silently export all detail rows. Label the worksheet with as-of date, filter context and the fact that counts span all matching authorized rows while details remain paged. Use ExcelExporter for typed numeric counts and formula-safe text, and existing HTTP OperationLogMiddleware for audit. Revoked/invalid requests return no file. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused workbook/UI tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated Excel summary endpoint reruns current-user menu, scope and request validation and returns only filtered-set status counts; denied or invalid calls return no workbook.
The workbook labels status counts, filter context and all-matching-row scope accurately, uses numeric cells and safe text, and contains no detail rows or out-of-scope data.
The designer downloads with current filters and reports errors; focused workbook/UI tests and safe Release build/test pass.
